rows.label: IRON
rows.clue: A heavy ductile magnetic metallic element

rows.label: TRAIN OIL
rows.clue: A white to brown oil obtained from whale blubber

rows.label: DEW
rows.clue: Water that has condensed on a cool surface overnight from water vapor in the air

rows.label: BOG SOIL
rows.clue: Poorly drained soils on top of peat and under marsh or swamp vegetation

rows.label: WOOL OIL
rows.clue: Any oil used to oil wool before spinning

rows.label: WAX
rows.clue: Any of various substances of either mineral origin or plant or animal origin

rows.label: MINERAL
rows.clue: Solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition

rows.label: PIG IRON
rows.clue: Crude iron tapped from a blast furnace

rows.label: SKI WAX
rows.clue: Wax used on the bottom of skis

rows.label: CHROMIUM
rows.clue: A hard brittle multivalent metallic element

rows.label: ICICLE
rows.clue: Ice resembling a pendent spear, formed by the freezing of dripping water

rows.label: NOBLE GAS
rows.clue: Any of the chemically inert gaseous elements of the helium group in the periodic table

rows.label: STEAM
rows.clue: Water at boiling temperature diffused in the atmosphere

rows.label: DROSS
rows.clue: Worthless or dangerous material that should be removed

rows.label: CRUDE
rows.clue: A dark oil consisting mainly of hydrocarbons

rows.label: DIMER
rows.clue: A compound whose molecules are composed of two identical monomers

rows.label: ACID DYE
rows.clue: Dye in which the chromophore is part of a negative ion

rows.label: WIRE WOOL
rows.clue: A mass of woven steel fibers used as an abrasive

rows.label: SCALE WAX
rows.clue: Partly refined paraffin wax

rows.label: HARDWOOD
rows.clue: The wood of broad-leaved dicotyledonous trees (as distinguished from the wood of conifers)

rows.label: PEAT
rows.clue: Partially carbonized vegetable matter saturated with water

rows.label: TWINS
rows.clue: (mineralogy) two interwoven crystals that are mirror images on each other

rows.label: QUARTZ
rows.clue: Colorless glass made of almost pure silica

rows.label: WATER
rows.clue: Binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid
